purpose: Separate 32x32 source addressing from multi-cell authored visual assemblies and gameplay structural footprints before cliff rendering/collision is reactivated.

measurementModel.sourceGridSpan: [column,row,widthCells,heightCells] is only the aligned source-sheet envelope used to address artwork.
measurementModel.sourceRectPx: [x,y,width,height] derived from sourceGridSpan; it is not a gameplay footprint.
measurementModel.tightVisualRectPx: opaque-pixel bounds inside the source sheet where audited; transparent overhang/padding is preserved by the aligned sourceRectPx.
measurementModel.worldVisualFootprintTiles: must be authored per normalized recipe and may differ from sourceGridSpan.
measurementModel.structuralHostMask: must be authored independently from the visual footprint.
measurementModel.collisionEdgeMask: must match a visible certified cliff boundary; never inferred from image dimensions.
measurementModel.traversalEdgeMask: exists only for explicit certified ramps, stairs, ladders, bridges, caves, and similar connectors.
measurementModel.criticalRule: 32x32 source cells are addresses, not automatically independent 1x1 world assets.

ogaLpcGrassTop.classification: specialist multi-cell stamp/reference kit; not a complete arbitrary cliff autotile family

elizawySeasonalCliffs.classification: primary structural cliff art family after exact recipe certification

elizawyRocksCliffs.classification: object/boulder/cliff-debris sheet; never structural platform-boundary authority

elizawyWaterfall.classification: animated multi-cell structural water connector; not a 1x1 terrain tile

acceptanceTarget.referenceSceneShape: large walkable plateau bounded by continuous authored cliff faces rather than small piles of standalone cliff blocks
acceptanceTarget.renderingRule: the resolver composes reviewed recipes and explicit connectors; certified visible structural edges block traversal, explicit Ramp/Stairs/Ladder/Bridge edges open, and missing visual authority fails open.
